title: Neural Memory Orchestration
abstract: arXiv:2611.23857v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern HPC workloads increasingly stall on the memory hierarchy rather than on compute, and page faults from mmap'd files, swap, and tiered memory are a growing fraction of wall time. Heuristic prefetchers in the kernel handle stride-like and temporally clustered patterns well but degrade sharply on the irregular, data-dependent access streams typical of these workloads. Learned prefetchers have been shown to capture such patterns in simulation but have not been taken to a deployed pipeline running against live workloads on real hardware. We present Overseer, an end-to-end learned page-prefetching system. An eBPF collector observes page faults on the target host, a transformer predictor (OverNet) runs on network-attached inference hardware and emits future page addresses, and a kernel-resident enforcer materializes those pages into the target's address space before they are demanded. OverNet encodes fault sequences through per-instance

translated_abstract: 现代高性能计算（HPC）工作负载越来越多地因内存层次结构而非计算而停滞，来自 mmap 文件、交换空间和分层内存的缺页中断在实际运行时间中所占的比例越来越大。内核中的启发式预取器能够较好地处理步长式和时间聚集的访问模式，但在这些工作负载典型的、不规则且依赖数据的访问流上性能会急剧下降。学习型预取器虽已被证明可在仿真中捕获此类模式，但尚未被部署为在真实硬件上针对真实工作负载运行的流水线。我们提出了 Overseer，一个端到端的学习型页面预取系统：一个 eBPF 采集器在目标主机上观测缺页事件，一个运行在联网推理硬件上的 transformer 预测器输出未来的页面地址，而一个常驻内核的执行器在这些页面被实际请求之前将其载入目标的地址空间。OverNet 通过逐实例……编码缺页序列
tldr: 提出了首个在真实硬件上针对真实工作负载端到端部署的学习型页面预取系统 Overseer，通过 eBPF 采集缺页事件、transformer 预测器（OverNet）预测未来页面地址、内核常驻执行器提前载入页面，从而缓解 HPC 工作负载因缺页中断造成的内存瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Overseer is the first end-to-end learned page-prefetching system deployed on real hardware against live workloads, combining an eBPF fault collector, a transformer predictor (OverNet), and a kernel-resident enforcer to materialize pages before they are demanded.
